links.effect: Deep learning substantially outperformed baselines externally (AUROC 0.956-0.963 vs. 0.630-0.686).
links.quote: Deep learning substantially outperformed baselines externally (AUROC 0.956-0.963 vs. 0.630-0.686).

links.outcome: Prospective-style performance and alert burden under simulated continuous monitoring versus single-point evaluation
links.effect: Highest single-point AUROC model (Masked CNN, 0.961) had worst deployment profile (NNE 17.6-564), while ITE-Transformer (AUROC 0.924) had NNE 1.5-2.4; longer horizons showed unstable trajectories.
links.quote: Notably, the highest single-point AUROC model (Masked CNN, 0.961) had the worst deployment profile (NNE 17.6-564), while ITE-Transformer (AUROC 0.924) achieved the most favourable alert burden (NNE 1.5-2.4).

links.outcome: Performance variation across sites under external validation
links.effect: External validation at Chuncheon and MIMIC-IV showed deep learning AUROC 0.956-0.963 versus baselines at 0.630-0.686, illustrating site-dependent variation in baseline performance.
links.quote: Deep learning substantially outperformed baselines externally (AUROC 0.956-0.963 vs. 0.630-0.686).

unlisted_practices: Online simulation framework generating predictions at 12-h intervals before onset to evaluate temporal trajectory (clinical faithfulness) of AUROC

screen.reason: Evaluates predictive AKI models under a simulated continuous monitoring framework (assessing alert burden/NNE and trajectory stability across horizons versus standard single-point validation).
